The '''Cavaell system''' was located in the [[Emmo sector/Legends|Emmo sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] known as [[Cavaellin Creams/Legends|Cavaellin spiced creams]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Cavaellin Creams/Legends|Cavaellin spiced creams]]|system=Cavaell [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cavaell [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
